svg.title: Lycanthropy — Blood Under the Moon. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Lycanthropy classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 6 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. The Beast Within forks into Blood on the Wind then Red Moon Rising. Moonbound Vigor forks into Lick the Wound then Undying Hunger. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Lycanthropy-classified jutsu (requires classification extension).

BUFF","adverse":false,"base":35.0,"gain":2,"final":37.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Undying Hunger"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Six nodes and two Advanced Arts rather than ten and four: the kit has three supported tags on five rows (Increase Damage Given x2, Damage x2, Heal x1), and Damage is left unamplified (traits Healing and Sustain, not Burst), so two tags carry the two 3-node chains: The Beast Within \u2192 Blood on the Wind \u2192 Red Moon Rising (frenzy) and Moonbound Vigor \u2192 Lick the Wound \u2192 Undying Hunger (regeneration). Draft 4's Damage chain, Gnashing Fangs (+2 Damage) \u2192 Jaws of the Alpha (+3 Damage), took Moonlit Fury 40 \u2192 45 and Feral Wrath 50 \u2192 55, and Gnashing Fangs alone put Feral Wrath at 52 as Red Moon Rising's fourth purchase; it is removed (7 \u2192 6 nodes) and Undying Hunger caps the Heal chain. A third route would need a Hidden Art that repeats Increase Damage Given (a twin of Blood on the Wind, and under The Beast Within a fourth purchase that lifts Red Moon Rising past +8%), repeats Heal on the one Heal row, or carries flat Damage, so none is added. Universal nodes accepted: with two 3-node chains every 4 BP build holds both Foundations, so the real choice is which chain to finish; the only other full build is the no-capstone hybrid (both Hidden Arts).","design_notes":["Structure: two 3-node chains, The Beast Within \u2192 Blood on the Wind \u2192 Red Moon Rising (Increase Damage Given +2/+2/+4%) and Moonbound Vigor \u2192 Lick the Wound \u2192 Undying Hunger (Heal +2/+2/+4%). Owning both Advanced Arts costs 6 BP, so a build holds one. Lick the Wound is the sustain commit and Undying Hunger the regeneration payoff; the Heal steps move from +2/+3/+3 so the bare capstone exceeds its Hidden Art's step, with the route total unchanged at +8% (480 HP), below the +10% single-row guardrail (which would add 20 HP per cast).","Damage: left unamplified because the dossier traits are Healing and Sustain, not Burst; Moonlit Fury 40 and Feral Wrath 50 stay at base in every legal allocation, so no row passes the Nuke tier. Draft 4's +5 Damage route (40 \u2192 45, 50 \u2192 55) and the previous pass's +2 Damage rider on Undying Hunger (flat Damage with only a Heal commit before it) are gone; a setup for a Damage payoff would twin Blood on the Wind, and Heal is not a commit for flat Damage.","Frenzy magnitude: each 35% row multiplies every element-less hit for the two rounds after its cast (Frenzy Assault's Taijutsu filter is not binding on an element-less row), and the two compound when both are up. Red Moon Rising's route is held at +8% rather than the +10% guardrail: \u00d71.43 \u00d7 1.43 \u2248 \u00d72.04 against \u00d71.82 at base, a compounded \u00d71.122 in a shared window (\u00d71.059 in a single one), under Blood-Enchanted Eyes' \u00d71.234 top package; +10% would give \u00d72.10.","Delivery: all three jutsu have cooldown 7. Frenzy Assault is a 40 AP self cast (Increase Damage Given 2 rounds; static Heal rounds 1 = one tick on the following round at 10 HP per heal power). Feral Wrath is a 60 AP ground circle whose Increase Damage Given row is SELF, realized on the caster at cast. Neither buff helps the round it is cast, Feral Wrath's own strike included (\u00a73b). Both windows coincide fully only when the two are cast in the same round (100 AP); cast one round apart, Frenzy Assault first, they share one round and Feral Wrath's strike lands under Frenzy Assault's buff. Feral Wrath's strike is therefore under at most one kit window; Moonlit Fury and off-kit hits can be under both.","Allocations: three legal full builds, each holding both Foundations and none dominated: Frenzy (01, 04, 05, 06: +8% Increase Damage Given, +2% Heal), Undying Hunger (01, 06, 07, 08: +2% Increase Damage Given, +8% Heal) and the no-capstone hybrid (01, 04, 06, 07: +4% Increase Damage Given, +4% Heal). Frenzy amplifies everything in the windows; Undying Hunger trades 6% of it for 60 HP per Frenzy Assault cast. Maxima over every legal allocation: Increase Damage Given +8%, Heal +8%, no flat Damage."],"risks":["Classification: no kit row carries a non-None element, so the tree requires a classification extension: 'Lycanthropy' is the placeholder name of a new jutsu classification assigned to jutsu records, not a bloodline-id selector; which jutsu carry it is a director/engine decision, and all three kit jutsu qualify only through it (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Targeting None instead would reach every non-elemental row in the game. Off-kit coverage is unverified.","Regeneration value: static Heal is 10 HP per point, so Undying Hunger's route adds 80 HP once per 7 rounds (400 \u2192 480), about 1.6% of a 5,050 HP level-100 pool (calcHP = 100 + 50 \u00d7 (level \u2212 1)); the +10% guardrail would add 20 HP more. With Damage unamplified that Heal is the route's whole pull, and the kit has no second sustain row to carry a secondary.","Frenzy breadth: both rows reach basic attacks, weapons and element-less normal jutsu as well as the kit, and the bloodline's Taijutsu Increase Damage Given passive multiplies last; extra damage also feeds the 10% lifesteal passive (shared 60% leech budget). Realized value depends on what lands in the windows; not simulated.","Unsupported rows: Moonlit Fury's wound 30% and cleanseprevent, and Feral Wrath's move, receive nothing; the two supported Damage rows stay at base by design. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in ranked PvP / sparring at the pin. No combat simulation was performed."],"design_review":{"status":"Fable proposal (2026-10-04 batch rebalance); not director-approved","foundation_sentences":{"01":"How do I make the frenzy hit harder?","06":"How do I outlast the fight?"},"route_identities":{"05":"sustained amplification: the full frenzy, every hit in the windows","08":"sustain: regeneration, the kit's one Heal row at +8% (480 HP per Frenzy Assault cast)"},"director_review":"Roster questions: DQ-H (7 \u2192 6 nodes: Draft 4's Damage chain, Gnashing Fangs \u2192 Jaws of the Alpha, is removed and Undying Hunger caps the Heal chain). Tree-specific: Undying Hunger's Heal-only route is worth 80 HP per 7-round Frenzy Assault cast (400 \u2192 480; 100 HP at the +10% guardrail), 60 HP more than the Frenzy build; confirm it as the Healing and Sustain trait's route beside Red Moon Rising.","concerns":["Undying Hunger is thin: its route is 80 HP per 7-round Frenzy Assault cast (400 \u2192 480), and against Frenzy it gives up 6% Increase Damage Given on both rows (\u00d71.37 against \u00d71.43 in one window; \u00d71.88 against \u00d72.04 with both up) for 60 HP more per cast. Draft 4 declined a Heal capstone for this reason; it stays because the traits are Healing and Sustain and without it Moonbound Vigor's chain has no payoff. Not simulated.","Six nodes against Draft 4's seven, and both Foundations are in every legal full build: no third Hidden Art exists that would not repeat Blood on the Wind or Lick the Wound or carry flat Damage.","Red Moon Rising's only fourth purchase, Moonbound Vigor, adds 20 HP per cast; accepted so that no second Increase Damage Given source sits beside the +8% route."]},"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":6,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":2,"advanced_art_count":2,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":6,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":3,"3":4,"4":3},"full_budget_allocations":3,"non_dominated_full_allocations":3,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":8,"heal":8},"supported_rows_in_kit":5,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":2,"heal":1,"increasedamagegiven":2},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["heal","increasedamagegiven"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":["damage"],"revision":"Fable proposal \u2014 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Lycanthropy classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).","Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Lycanthropy-classified jutsu (requires classification extension). Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.","Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.","Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Lycanthropy-classified jutsu (requires classification extension). Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 6 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Red Moon Rising path + Moonbound Vigor
Undying Hunger path + The Beast Within
IDG: Increase Damage Given · HEAL: Heal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE LYCANTHROPY KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
On a static Heal effect each +1% Heal adds 1 heal power, which heals 10 HP per tick (display conflict under review).
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
3 legal four-skill allocations · 2 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Lycanthropy classification / forked tree
